sloka: पुण्ये नक्षत्रयोगे च रामो राज्यमवाप्नुयात् ।इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सूतपुत्रो महात्मनः ॥२-१४-४३॥
transliteration: puṇye nakṣatrayoge ca rāmo rājyamavāpnuyāt ।iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sūtaputro mahātmanaḥ ॥2-14-43॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of the great Vasistha, charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment, singing the praise of this tiger among kings (Dasaratha).
